Objects.requireNonNull(revision, "revision");
return client.sql("INSERT INTO telemetry.event_revisions (device_id, metric, t_device, revision, t_ingress, validation_status, raw_payload) VALUES (:deviceId, :metric, :tDevice, :revision, :tIngress, :validationStatus, :rawPayload)")
    .bind("deviceId", revision.deviceId())
    .bind("metric", revision.metric())
    .bind("tDevice", revision.tDevice())
    .bind("revision", revision.revision())
    .bind("tIngress", revision.tIngress())
    .bind("validationStatus", revision.validationStatus())
    .bind("rawPayload", revision.rawPayload())
    .fetch()
    .rowsUpdated();
